      • applyPotionEffects

        @ParametersAreNonnullByDefault
public static void applyPotionEffects(org.bukkit.entity.Player p,
                                                                     SlimefunArmorPiece sfArmorPiece)
        Applies every PotionEffect of the given SlimefunArmorPiece to the Player. Shared between the periodic tick and the PlayerArmorChangeEvent listener so effects can be applied immediately on equip instead of waiting for the next tick.
        Parameters:
        p - The Player wearing the piece of armor
        sfArmorPiece - The SlimefunArmorPiece whose effects should be applied
